findings.body: The mapping tests beginning here exercise only hand-constructed entries passed to `validateFinancialMappingSeed`; none asserts the exported `FINANCIAL_MAPPING_SEED`. Consequently, the production transformation from `MAPPING_MASTER` could emit no mappings, omit aliases, change target keys, or lose provisional status while every new test still passes. Add a test of the actual exported seed covering DUB ownership, governed aliases, target identities, and approval metadata.
